'''Stanton Rendar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and the brother of [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
An ambitious young [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], Stanton worked his way up through the ranks of the family shipping company, [[RenTrans]], unwilling to simply inherit a cushy job. He wanted to prove himself as a capable [[Pilot/Legends|starship pilot]] on his own terms. His equally talented brother, [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]], displayed a promising flight performance in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]].<Ref name="sotesb">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Meanwhile, [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], who had made an offer to the Rendars to make RenTrans a part of his company, [[Xizor Transport Systems/Legends|Xizor Transport Systems]] refused. [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Sprax]], on Xizor's orders, arranged his operatives and technicians to sabotage Stanton's [[bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]] ''[[Doriella's Mystress]]'' hoping to either scare the Rendars into selling, or disgrace them in the eyes of the Emperor.<ref name="merger">{{WEGCite|story=The Business Merger|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>
===Death===
On [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], as Stanton was lifting off from [[docking pad RT209]], the ship's control systems failed, causing it to lose control and crash into [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] private museum. Not only Stanton was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the resulting explosion, but many irreplacable [[Jedi artifact/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] were destroyed, and, as Sprax's agents rigged the ''Mystress'' with explosives, the disaster affected even the lower levels of the city.<Ref name="sotesb" /><ref name="merger" />

Palpatine was enraged by the destruction of his museum and seized RenTrans' assets, banished the Rendars from the Core Worlds and threw their younger son Dash out of the Academy.<Ref name="sotesb" />

===Human replica droid===
{{Main|Stanton Rendar (droid)}}
Years later, after Dash Rendar had become a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and mercenary, he met [[Guri]], a highly advanced [[Human replica droid]] (HRD) who had once worked for Xizor.<ref>[[Shadows of the Empire: Evolution 5|''Shadows of the Empire: Evolution'' 5]]</ref> Although they had been old enemies, he partnered with her to create [[Onadax Droid Technologies]] (ODT), a company that eventually developed a process to place the essence of a living being into an HRD. He used this technology to recreate his brother Stanton.
